as_told.title: Tim Taylor's manuscript with Townsend Brown's daughter

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor helped a woman named Linda Brown write her book on Thomas Townsend Brown, a scientist Michels has described as a CIA scientist who built UFO-like craft. The work was done sometime between 2010 and 2013. Chris Bledsoe, a man NASA is said to study because UFOs seem to show up around him, tells Michels this as something Taylor told him, and adds that he has the book's manuscript saved on his phone.
